reviews.summary: The counting check, the effort table and the card lines are usable at once, but 'pick one' then allowed two, one sample line didn't quite make sense, and one skip-list label was too abstract.

Template claims check out, but the jar and Letter notes, the /occasions link sentence, the 100-reasons sentence and one sample detail echoed older posts; the /occasions link implied more wrappable gifts; the ES jar note told the reader to shake the phone; and the Spanish had 'la escala justa', 'gana a caro' and 'media historia'.
'That don't overdo it' and the effort table beat page one's unsorted listicles, but 'by spring' only fits an autumn reader of an evergreen post.

applied: /occasions/anniversary link now says what's there: digital anniversary gifts made from your photos and song (EN and ES).
Jar of Reasons and The Letter notes rewritten from the manifests so they no longer echo other posts; ES jar note has the recipient shake the phone.
100-reasons sentence and the 'hum when you cook' sample replaced (EN and ES).
'Pick one, two at most'; skip label 'Measuring how they feel by the calendar'; the Fridays line rewritten.
'By spring' removed: 'Even a good card ends up in a drawer.'
Spanish: «eso es lo justo», «Algo hecho o elegido con cuidado vale más que algo caro», «así tenéis más que contar».

Polish taken: long-distance section names what to send; birthday-budget fallback for couples without a birthday yet; Our Timeline countdown 'if you set one'; heading 'Keep the six months in one place'; sharper description; ES present tense, «con la misma postura», «de tu pareja».
rejected: A gift idea aimed at him: the keyword names no one, so the post stays neutral.
A link to the long-distance birthday post: it's about birthdays; the queued long-distance anniversary post will be the right link.

reviews.summary: Round-1 fixes read clearly; sized to six months with an effort table, a spending limit, card lines and the only 'what to skip' list.

All round-1 fixes landed, but the long-distance section's 'letter timed to open that morning' implies scheduling, which is premium, two sections before the post says The Letter is free; the same sentence stacked two 'rather than' contrasts.
'By spring' is gone; the effort table, counting check, card lines and skip list beat page one's unsorted listicles, with no overlap with the queued posts.

applied: Long-distance send list: 'a letter by email, scheduled for that morning' (no premium feature implied), and 'one plan with a start and an end' (EN and ES).
Polish taken: Our Timeline note split so 'the best part' is clearly what comes next (EN and ES); «en vez de envolverlo»; 'at each end'.
rejected: A link to long-distance-anniversary-ideas: that post isn't published yet.
Reworking the takeaways' contrast pairs: the reviewer advised leaving them.

reviews.summary: Round-2 changes read correctly; sized to six months, with a plan, a spending limit, card lines and the 'what to skip' list behind the real worry.
Every claim matches the code and the round-2 fixes landed, but the ES Letter note's subjectless «Rompe» read as an instruction to the giver rather than the recipient.
Round-2 changes touch nothing search depends on; still the only result sized to six months, with no overlap with the queued posts.

applied: ES Letter note: «Tu pareja rompe el sello…».

Polish taken: comma removed in the long-distance list; «cuando cumpláis un año» for «al año»; «capricho» for «picoteo»; 'an evening one later'; one sentence on why a link helps before the templates (EN and ES).
rejected: A link to long-distance-anniversary-ideas: not published yet.
Reworking the takeaways' contrast pairs: optional, and each reads fine.

reviews.summary: Round-3 changes read correctly; sized for six months, with a plan by effort, a spending limit, card lines and the only 'what to skip' list.
Every claim matches the code, no sentence repeats another post, and the Spanish reads as written in Spain.
Covers every idea page one recurs on, adds why each fits six months, and leaves the queued anniversary and long-distance posts their searches.

rejected: Final-round polish recorded, not applied: a link to long-distance-anniversary-ideas once it's published (search); «lo hicisteis oficial» and «vale más que» in the ES (editor).
